encoding: one length byte, then ASCII text, then hex of packed little-endian frame

outer_transport.string_layout: first payload byte is the string length (herdsman DEBUG.msg string prefix); remaining bytes are the T832D2: hex text

packet: constant RAM slot; host collector establishes reboot association from BOOT record plus sequence/uptime discontinuity
T832_BUILD_ID: candidate short git SHA baked at build time
record: record sequence; 0 for live-built system records
bit0=critical, bit1=snapshot re-emit, bits7..2=original kind on FIRST_FAULT snapshots

event_semantics.HEALTH: live-built, sequence 0; a=MT schedules since last accepted health baseline (saturated, nonzero under scheduling), b=MT actual-work age ms, c=NPI transport-work age ms
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=1: b=RX high-water bytes, c=max approximate normal NPI queue depth
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=2: b=max observed TX-active age ms, c=Zigbee-stack work age ms
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=5: b/c=oldest normal-pending age ms low/high (0 when none)
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=6: b/c=telemetry export-loss counter low/high (own bounded loss accounting, never a radio fault)
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=7: R5: always unavailable (0xFFFF/0xFFFF); heap traversal disabled pending bench timing. R4 with capability bit18: free/largest in 16-byte units.
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=8: b=diagnostic TX completions, c=sync-SRSP TX completions (saturated 16 bit)
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=9: b=AF confirmed count, c=AF rejected count (saturated 16 bit)
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=10: b=last MT command cmd0<<8|cmd1, c=its age ms (saturated)
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=11: b=last startup stage, c=its age ms (saturated)
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=12: b=ZStack-task work age ms (0xFFFF until first genuine ZStack-task observation; MT-side startup never refreshes it), c=NPI-task wake age ms (saturated)
event_semantics.RESOURCE:a=13: b=normal TX completions, c=unsolicited TX completions (saturated 16 bit)
event_semantics.TASK_EVENTS: live-built; a=last MT task event bits, b=sticky MT task event bits since boot, c=low 16 of total MT schedule count
event_semantics.NV_EVENT: a=1 compact begin (b=min bytes), a=2 compact end ok (b=status, c=duration ms), a=5 NV init normal (b=init action)
event_semantics.AF_STATE: live-built; a=AF requests accepted and awaiting confirm, b=oldest age ms, c=max outstanding
event_semantics.NV_FAULT: a=3 compact failure (b=status, c=duration ms), a=4 recovery reformat entry (b=NV page count), or a=0 abnormal NV init (b=init action)
event_semantics.TX_MISMATCH: queue/dequeue/wire ownership anomaly; a=1 bad SOF, 2 older retired unknown-outcome on deeper match, 4 pending underflow, 5 TX FIFO full (newest refused, never evicted), 6 double diag queue, 7 finish without dequeue, 9 dequeue over in-flight, 10 untracked wire completion, 11 write-rejected in-flight released, 12 orphan owned entry released, 13 uncertain release, 14 refusal of untracked frame
event_semantics.SYNC_ABANDON: a=1 new SREQ superseded an outstanding sync round-trip (fresh generation), 2 stale SRSP completion left suppression set
event_semantics.AF_REJECT: AF request refused (SREQ status) or confirm failed (nonzero confirm status) with raw status c; a=src endpoint, b=transID
event_semantics.AF_ANOMALY: a=1 orphan/duplicate confirm, 4 accept-table overflow (largest-age entry evicted), 5 transaction reuse superseded in place, 6 unexpected AF SRSP, 7 truncated request payload; b=endpoint, c=transID
event_semantics.DIAG_LOSS: telemetry's own bounded loss; a=lost records (or 2=staged-retire identity mismatch, nothing retired), b=1 MT build refusal, 2 NPI-side drop
event_semantics.NPI_TRAP: central NPI RX overflow trap site; a=attempted size, b=available space; trap preserved after recording
event_semantics.NPI_ALLOC_FAIL: allocation refusal; a=1 NPI TX path (b=stage 1 frame/2 queue-record/3 unsupported in sendToHost, 4/5/6 in processStackMsg; only the owned entry is reconciled), 2 NPI RX path (no TX state touched)
event_semantics.FIRST_FAULT: sticky first critical record re-emitted with the snapshot flag; a/b/c/repeat keep the original payload, flags bits7..2 carry the original event kind; never overwritten by ring pressure
event_semantics.TIMING_APPROX: pre-scheduler records exist with assumed 1 ms tick; a=count of pre-scheduler records, b=MT task id; their timing is approximate
event_semantics.BLOCK_SNAPSHOT: a=index 0..12 below; b=current, c=lifetime maximum; all values/ages saturated uint16. Index0 c=sticky mask union. RAM has full uint32 ages. Updated before EVERY export gate, including limiter. Fragment timestamps are sample times, not export times.
event_semantics.PIPELINE: a=0: b=current generation, c=SREQ cmd0<<8|cmd1; a=1: b=furthest stage, c=observed stage bitmask; a=2..11: b=max RX-to-stage latency ms for stage a-1, c=current generation. Historical maxima span all generations in this boot; they are not per-request samples. Callbacks can precede write-accepted return; mask records observations without inventing chronological order.
event_semantics.UART_EVENT: a=0..5: b=saturated count, c=age since last event (0xFFFF unavailable/saturated): accepted, write callback, TX_BEGIN, TX_FINISHED, RX callback, rejected. a=6: b=raw signed16 RX status, c=raw signed16 write status. a=7: b=current accepted-no-FINISHED age, c=sticky max. a=8: b/c=attempted RX callback bytes low/high32. a=9: b=sticky public error-event mask (framing/parity/break/overrun bits0..3), c=saturated error callback count. a=10: b=last error age, c=0. Accepted/copied RX bytes remain RESOURCE:3; attempted overflow bytes remain NPI_RX_OVERFLOW.
event_semantics.NWK_PRESSURE: a=index below; b=current occupancy, c=lifetime max. Sample timestamp is first_ms/last_ms. 0xFFFF current if not yet sampled. Configured capacities are in diag_manifest.json; queue API is byte-returning. Sample may be old when ZStack task does not progress; never infer a fresh zero.
event_semantics.NWK_LIMIT: a=NWK index, b=configured capacity, c=0; emitted once when a nonzero limit is first observed. SENT/HOLD/DONE use the shared total buffer ceiling, not independent per-state quotas.
event_semantics.TASK_STAT: a=0/1: b=TI Task_Mode, c=stack size for NPI/shared OSAL-ZStack; a=2/3: b=used stack watermark, c=handle validity. Task_stat runs once per 60 s in MT task context. Timestamp0 indicates unavailable/unrun. Shared OSAL handle may also execute MT; this is not proof of three independent tasks.
event_semantics.BOOT_TIMING: a=1 MT init,2 UART configured,3 first genuine ZStack event,4 first SYS SRSP wire completion after successful MT RPC return,5 same for ZDO; b/c=boot uptime low/high32. Milestones4/5 prove RPC/wire progress, not operation-specific success; host-owner ZDO proof remains required. Early milestone2 clock is approximate until MT initializes tick period.
event_semantics.BOOT: a=reset source; decoder supplies symbolic class from pinned AON enum; c=validity. 0=PWR_ON,1=PIN_RESET,2=VDDS_LOSS,4=VDDR_LOSS,5=CLK_LOSS,6=SYSRESET,7=WARMRESET,8=shutdown wake,9=TCK wake; other=UNKNOWN. Host boot epoch is persisted, wire boot_session stays constant.

r6_capabilities.28: Pristine TI driver-callback completion; frame-bound wire finish unavailable (bit5 clear)
r6_capabilities.29: NV POD topology/counters sampled after serialized API boundaries; legacy timed NV capability14 absent

r6_semantics.NV_TOPOLOGY: a0:b pages,c ready; a1:b head,c tail; a2:b active,c offset
r6_semantics.NV_SPACE: a page index,b offset,c raw page state; a65535:b/c free RAM estimate low/high32 (last API boundary; not flash scan)
r6_semantics.NV_COUNTERS: a0 add-item attempts (create/update/write that reached addItem; excludes reads, deletes and already-existing creates),a1 automatic get-destination compactions,a2 failures of those compactions; b/c counter low/high32. Explicit compactNV API calls are visible in NV_RESULT rather than these automatic-compaction counters.
r6_semantics.NV_RESULT: a last stage,b requested length (zero for delete, requested minimum free bytes for explicit compact),c raw status; a7:b init action,c first storage failure. Completed-API EXIST/NOTFOUND are recorded but do not latch a storage fault. No item identity or payload.
r6_semantics.NPI_WRITE_COMPLETE: a bytes,b driver callback age,c pending; explicitly not physical UART idle
r6_semantics.BOOT_TIMING: R6 milestones6/7 are SYS/ZDO driver callbacks; milestones4/5 are unavailable
r6_semantics.PIPELINE: With capability28, stages9/10 are unbound and unavailable. TX events count separately.
r6_semantics.timestamps: NV record timestamps mark deferred sampling, not the original NV API instant.
r6_semantics.NV_FAULT: a8 is the sticky first NV failure: b raw status,c request bytes at that first failure; exported from POD to the critical ring. Topology records are last API boundary, not first-failure topology.
